name: Vulnify
description: Hosted Vulnify MCP server at https://mcp.vulnify.io/mcp. An agent describes an action (agent, action, resource, destination, record count) and gets ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK with a risk score and reasons. decide_action and check_mcp_tool_call record a decision in the caller's Vulnify organization; the other tools only read or dry-run. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Dry-run check_action/test_policies (and plan_policy_changes with dryRun true) record nothing; a REVIEW from them does not open human review. Record via decide_action or check_mcp_tool_call first.
A recorded REVIEW waits for a person in the Vulnify app or Slack; this server cannot approve or deny. Treat tool errors as not allowed, never as ALLOW.
